translations.web: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
translations.bsb: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.
translations.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
translations.asv: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal: Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
